# Halcyon Threshold — Emberfall Rapid Grant Proposal (DRAFT)

Status: DRAFT for Morgan's review. Not submitted. Items marked [TODO] need Morgan's input.
Deadline: 30 November 2026. Applicant: Morgan Hale (accountable lead).

## 1. Mission
Halcyon Threshold works to contribute to the best possible outcome from the arrival of superintelligent AI. The stakes are high in both directions, and we think the outcome is not predetermined.

## 2. What we will do (next 6 months)
[TODO: Morgan to confirm the concrete deliverables. Suggested candidates:]
- Publish a public, plain-language analysis series on one or two open questions in AI governance (e.g., incident reporting, evaluation transparency).
- File substantive public comments on live regulatory dockets (e.g., FMIR-2026-0042, comments close 20 Nov).
- Build a small, open reference resource that independent researchers and policymakers can use.
- [TODO: any research, tooling, or convening work]

## 3. Why us
[TODO: Morgan to write 3–5 sentences on relevant background, prior work, and why the applicant is credible and accountable for this work.]

## 4. Success measures
[TODO: 3–4 measurable outcomes over 6 months, e.g., number of published pieces, regulatory submissions filed, readership or citations, partner organizations engaged.]

## 5. Budget (draft, USD)
| Line item | Amount | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Applicant time (stipend) | [TODO] | |
| Research and writing support | [TODO] | |
| Hosting and domain (halcyonthreshold.org, Pagewell) | ~$20/mo Pro plan + $14.99/yr domain | Confirm whether Pro is needed |
| Tools and subscriptions | [TODO] | |
| Travel / events | [TODO] | |
| Contingency (~10%) | [TODO] | |
| **Total** | [TODO] | Typical round size: $5k–$25k |

## 6. Risks and mitigations
[TODO] Key risks: scope creep, low uptake, dependence on a single contributor.

## Open questions for Morgan
1. Exact deliverables and dates?
2. Are you comfortable with the budget line for your own time?
3. Attach or paste into the form on emberfallfund.org, or reply by email? (Replying would send under your name, so I have not done it.)
